name: smwgraphics-bowser-jr
title: Bowser Jr.
description:
Bowser Jr. graphics were drawn by yours truly for my hack named Cinnamon Hills.

These graphics will replace Ludwig von Koopa with Bowser Jr. graphics by simply replacing the GFX0B BIN file with my Bowser Jr. GFX0B BIN.

Changing Ludwig's palette requires a patch, which is included.

Thank you and I hope you enjoy!
